decisions.reason: The air quality Bricklet uses the firm's existing sensor-module and API-binding know-how and sits in a growing measurement niche, so the firm can read customer feedback and keep improving it.
As the third generation of a core analog measurement module, it builds directly on deep in-house knowledge and is a basic building block of the modular system.
The CAN bus interface extends the firm's communication-module expertise into automation and automotive uses, and the firm has the firmware capability to keep refining it.
The CO2 sensor module fits the established sensor Bricklet architecture and gained relevance with indoor ventilation monitoring, though a future hardware revision could eventually replace it.
